## `AuthValidateAccessToken`

**GET** `/identity/v2/auth/access_token/validate`

Validate Access Token

Validates an Access Token, returning its expiry if valid, or an error if invalid.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallAuthValidateAccessToken(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    Option<string> accessToken = new Option<string>("<accessToken>"); //Optional

    try {
        var response = await client.Session.AuthValidateAccessTokenAsync(accessToken);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | query | string | no | Access Token of the User |

### Returns

`AccessTokenResponse`

## `InvalidateAccessToken`

**GET** `/identity/v2/auth/access_token/invalidate`

Invalidate Access Token

Invalidates an active Access Token, expiring its validity.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallInvalidateAccessToken(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    Option<bool> preventRefresh = new Option<bool>(true); //Optional

    try {
        var response = await client.Session.InvalidateAccessTokenAsync(preventRefresh);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preventRefresh` | query | boolean | no | Whether to prevent the token from being refreshed (true/false). |

### Returns

`IsPostedResponse`
